title: Yellowed Filipino Duck Legs Skewers
description: A cultured and creamy solo dinner dish featuring duck legs, grilled to perfection with a blend of Filipino flavors and ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, grated ginger, garlic, black pepper, and salt.
Add the duck legs to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated duck legs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each leg.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the duck legs for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 165 degrees.
Brush the duck legs with the remaining marinade during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the grilled duck legs hot, garnished with bruised lemon grass and a side of steamed vegetables.
